name: joint-pilot-v0
scope: CPU dense-mask differentiable GPTNeoX proxy; all six attention layers changed. Not efficient sparse execution or Qwen architecture. One paired seed is exploratory.
evaluation: Fixed final checkpoint; primary late-token next-token NLL, native sparse masks for both sparse methods; dense diagnostic on final sparse weights also recorded without checkpoint selection.
gate: A cold-start gap is actionable only if sparse_step0 is worse than sparse_warmup by >=0.02 nats in both development and test. This allows further LOCAL mechanism work, not cloud expansion or an originality claim.
rationale: Failed uniform-probe and sampled-head-normalizer candidates are closed. Measure whether a joint-training cold-start problem actually appears before designing further methods. Native training and warmup already have prior work.
